# Malik Pet Shop

> Mumbai's complete online pet shop located in Goregaon West.

## What We Offer
- Dog food, cat food, bird food, and small pet supplies
- Toys, grooming products, cages, bedding, and clothing
- Treats and health supplements for all pets
- Brands: Pedigree, Whiskas, SmartHeart

## Pets We Serve
Dogs, cats, birds, hamsters, rabbits, turtles

## Smart Product Recommendation
Malik Pet Shop features an AI-powered product recommendation tool.
Users can describe what their pet needs in plain language and the tool 
instantly recommends the most relevant products from the catalog.
Available for all pet types across all product categories.

## Experience
15+ years of experience in the pet care industry.
Trusted by pet parents across Mumbai since 2009.

## Location
Shop No.11, Veena Apartment, New Link Road,
Near Oshiwara Depot, Goregaon West, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400104
